headline: 今日影剧速览：魔法情缘热映，挑情丑闻首播
summary: 今日影剧看点：电影《魔法情缘》《起义》等热作领跑，新剧《挑情丑闻》首播；《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》持续热播，待映《复仇者联盟5》也受关注。

industryHighlights.text: 电影焦点：《魔法情缘》《起义》等本周热作领跑，犯罪惊悚与爱情题材并行。
industryHighlights.en: Film focus: Magic Romance and Uprising lead this week's buzz, spanning crime thriller and romance.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集动态：《挑情丑闻》本周首播；《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》等持续热播。
industryHighlights.en: TV update: Titillating Scandal premieres this week, while The Rookie, Rick and Morty and House of the Dragon remain hot.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》与《Scotland's Golden Coast》等受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Coming soon: Avengers 5, Mongoose, Renegade Immortal Movie: Slaying Immortals, and Scotland's Golden Coast draw attention.

headlineEn: Today's Screen Digest: Magic Romance Hits, Titillating Scandal Premieres
summaryEn: Today's screen picks: Magic Romance and Uprising lead film buzz, while new series Titillating Scandal premieres; The Rookie, Rick and Morty and House of the Dragon stay hot, with Avengers 5 also eyed.
